name: RichTextInput
description:
A Markdown document with an editable visual view and optional source view. The toolbar
uses Glass UX Button, Segmented, Menu and Popover controls. Supports paragraphs,
headings, quotes, fenced code, bold, italic, inline code, strike-through, lists,
task lists, links and inline images. Unsupported syntax remains available in source.
The editing engine loads only when this component renders.
signature: ({ value, defaultValue, onValueChange, minHeight, maxHeight, className, style, ...props }: RichTextInputProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: IDs of supporting or validation text.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for a bare input.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: IDs providing the accessible name.

props.name: attachmentAccept
props.description: File picker accept attribute used by the upload adapter. Default unrestricted.

props.name: className
props.description: Outer layout classes.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial Markdown when the host does not control value. Default empty.

props.name: defaultView
props.description: Initial presentation for an uncontrolled view. Default visual.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable editing, toolbar controls and source switching.

props.name: id
props.description: ID of the active editing surface. Field supplies a label when wrapped.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Mark a bare input invalid; RichTextField derives this from validation.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Maximum content height, in CSS pixels; longer documents scroll. Default 480.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: Minimum content height, in CSS pixels. Default 160. Toolbar height is additional.

props.name: name
props.description: Native form field name; its value is Markdown.

props.name: onAttachmentError
props.description: Reports an upload failure to the host; an inline message also explains it.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when focus leaves the complete editor, including its toolbar.

props.name: onError
props.description: Receives an editing-engine error; the original Markdown remains available in source view.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: The next Markdown after an edit. View changes do not rewrite the document.

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: Called when a person chooses Visual or Markdown.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Prompt shown in an empty document. Default "Write a document…".

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Prevent edits while allowing reading, selection and source inspection.

props.name: ref
props.description: Receives the visible editing surface for focus.

props.name: required
props.description: Announce that the document is required. Validate with richTextSchema.

props.name: resize
props.description: Allow vertical resizing of the editing surface between its limits. Default true.

props.name: sourceView
props.description: Offer the Markdown source view. Labels become named Eye/Code icons before formatting wraps. Default true.

props.name: spellCheck
props.description: Enable browser spelling checks. Default true.

props.name: style
props.description: Outer layout styles.

props.name: uploadAttachment
props.description: Host-owned upload adapter. When supplied, the toolbar offers Attach file.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled Markdown source. HTML and editor JSON are never emitted.

props.name: view
props.description: Controlled presentation. Default visual; the visual view is directly editable.
